release_body:
NeuroCVguard 0.1.0 is the first research release. It helps check whether a study's training and test splits match its evaluation objective.

### Included in this release

- Cohort audits for participant overlap, declared relationships and site separation.
- Grouped split generation and preprocessing provenance checks.
- Participant-level logistic regression with optional nested regularization selection.
- Descriptive comparisons of evaluation designs.
- Offline HTML/JSON reports and five synthetic tutorials.

Install with Python 3.11 or newer:

```text
python -m pip install neurocvguard==0.1.0
python -m neurocvguard demo --out local_outputs/demo
```

### Scope and limitations

Repeated visits alone are not leakage, and site separation depends on the study objective. Unknown upstream preprocessing remains unassessable. Associations and score differences do not establish causality. Private split and evaluation files contain identifiers; reports are not guaranteed anonymous. Regression, changing longitudinal targets and temporal evaluation are unsupported. This is research software, not a clinical validation tool.

The maintainer walkthrough and independent-user trial remain outstanding. Development assistance and review are documented in [AI_ASSISTANCE.md](https://github.com/Alireza2177/NeuroCVguard/blob/main/AI_ASSISTANCE.md).

### Verification

The release passed 733 local tests and a [six-job CI matrix](https://github.com/Alireza2177/NeuroCVguard/actions/runs/36299543058) covering Linux, Windows, macOS and the direct dependency floor. Public GitHub and PyPI files match the recorded hashes, and a fresh public-wheel installation passed. See [release verification](https://github.com/Alireza2177/NeuroCVguard/blob/main/docs/release.md) for details.
